/-- Represenation of Zig error sets for slice operations. -/
inductive ZigError where
  | NotFound : ZigError
  | IndexOutOfBounds : ZigError
  | Overflow : ZigError
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Error Union type `E ! T` in Zig semantics. -/
inductive Result (E : Type) (A : Type) where

/-- Operational loop step function representing the exact `while` loop execution in Zig. -/
def searchAux (l : List Nat) (target : Nat) (currIdx : Nat) : Result ZigError Nat :=
  match l with
  | [] => Result.err ZigError.NotFound
  | x :: xs =>
    match hdec : x == target with
    | true => Result.ok currIdx
    | false => searchAux xs target (currIdx + 1)

/-- Entry point function corresponding to Zig `linearSearch`. -/
def zigLinearSearch (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target : Nat) : Result ZigError Nat :=
  searchAux s.elements target 0

/-- Slice length property corresponding to `slice.len`. -/
def zigLen (s : ZigSlice Nat) : Nat :=
  s.elements.length

/-- Checked indexing corresponding to `slice[i]`. -/

  match s.elements.get? idx with
  | Some v => Result.ok v
  | None => Result.err ZigError.IndexOutOfBounds

def nat_zero_le : ∀ (n : Nat), 0 ≤ n
  | 0 => Nat.le.refl
  | n + 1 => Nat.le.step (nat_zero_le n)

def nat_le_refl (n : Nat) : n ≤ n := Nat.le.refl

def nat_le_succ (n : Nat) : n ≤ n + 1 := Nat.le.step Nat.le.refl

def nat_le_trans : ∀ {a b c : Nat}, a ≤ b → b ≤ c → a ≤ c
  | _, _, _, h1, Nat.le.refl => h1
  | _, _, _, h1, Nat.le.step h2 => Nat.le.step (nat_le_trans h1 h2)

def nat_succ_le_succ : ∀ {a b : Nat}, a ≤ b → a + 1 ≤ b + 1
  | _, _, Nat.le.refl => Nat.le.refl
  | _, _, Nat.le.step h => Nat.le.step (nat_succ_le_succ h)

def nat_le_of_succ_le_succ : ∀ {a b : Nat}, a + 1 ≤ b + 1 → a ≤ b
  | a, _, Nat.le.refl => Nat.le.refl
  | a, _, Nat.le.step h => nat_le_trans (Nat.le.step Nat.le.refl) (nat_le_of_succ_le_succ h)

def nat_le_add_right (a : Nat) : ∀ (b : Nat), a ≤ a + b
  | 0 => Nat.le.refl
  | b + 1 => Nat.le.step (nat_le_add_right a b)

def nat_lt_add_succ (currIdx len : Nat) : currIdx < currIdx + (len + 1) :=
  nat_succ_le_succ (nat_le_add_right currIdx len)

def nat_add_right_succ (a : Nat) : ∀ (b : Nat), (a + 1) + b = a + (b + 1)
  | 0 => rfl
  | b + 1 => congrArg Nat.succ (nat_add_right_succ a b)

def nat_lt_add_assoc {idx currIdx len : Nat} (h : idx < (currIdx + 1) + len) : idx < currIdx + (len + 1) :=
  Eq.mp (congrArg (Nat.le (idx + 1)) (nat_add_right_succ currIdx len)) h

def nat_eq_of_beq_true : ∀ (a b : Nat), (a == b) = true → a = b
  | 0, 0, _ => rfl
  | 0, _ + 1, h => nomatch h
  | _ + 1, 0, h => nomatch h
  | a + 1, b + 1, h => congrArg Nat.succ (nat_eq_of_beq_true a b h)

def nat_ne_of_beq_false : ∀ (a b : Nat), (a == b) = false → a = b → False
  | 0, 0, h, _ => nomatch h
  | 0, _ + 1, _, h2 => nomatch h2
  | _ + 1, 0, _, h2 => nomatch h2
  | a + 1, b + 1, h, h2 => nat_ne_of_beq_false a b h (match h2 with | rfl => rfl)

def nat_beq_refl : ∀ (a : Nat), (a == a) = true
  | 0 => rfl
  | a + 1 => nat_beq_refl a

def nat_sub_succ_eq : ∀ (currIdx idx : Nat), currIdx < idx → idx - currIdx = (idx - (currIdx + 1)) + 1
  | 0, 0, h => nomatch h
  | 0, _ + 1, _ => rfl
  | currIdx + 1, idx + 1, h => nat_sub_succ_eq currIdx idx (nat_le_of_succ_le_succ h)

def nat_succ_le_of_le_and_ne : ∀ {a b : Nat}, a ≤ b → (b == a) = false → a + 1 ≤ b
  | 0, 0, _, hne => nomatch hne
  | 0, b + 1, _, _ => nat_succ_le_succ (nat_zero_le b)
  | a + 1, b + 1, hle, hne => nat_succ_le_succ (nat_succ_le_of_le_and_ne (nat_le_of_succ_le_succ hle) hne)

def nat_lt_irrefl : ∀ (n : Nat), n < n → False
  | 0, h => nomatch h
  | n + 1, h => nat_lt_irrefl n (nat_le_of_succ_le_succ h)

def nat_zero_add : ∀ (n : Nat), 0 + n = n
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => congrArg Nat.succ (nat_zero_add n)

def nat_lt_of_lt_zero_add {idx len : Nat} (h : idx < 0 + len) : idx < len :=
  Eq.mp (congrArg (Nat.le (idx + 1)) (nat_zero_add len)) h

def nat_lt_zero_add {idx len : Nat} (h : idx < len) : idx < 0 + len :=
  Eq.mpr (congrArg (Nat.le (idx + 1)) (nat_zero_add len)) h


-- ============================================================================
-- 4. INDUCTIVE OPERATIONAL LEMMAS FOR THE LOOP STEP
-- ============================================================================

/-- Lemma 1: Any successfully returned index is strictly within the search bounds. -/
def searchAux_bounds : ∀ (l : List Nat) (target currIdx idx : Nat),
    searchAux l target currIdx = Result.ok idx →
    currIdx ≤ idx ∧ idx < currIdx + l.length
  | [], _, _, _, h => nomatch h
  | x :: xs, target, currIdx, idx =>
    match hdec : x == target with
    | true =>
      fun h =>
        match h with
        | rfl =>
          And.intro
            (nat_le_refl currIdx)
            (nat_lt_add_succ currIdx xs.length)
    | false =>
      fun h =>
        have ih := searchAux_bounds xs target (currIdx + 1) idx h
        And.intro
          (nat_le_trans (nat_le_succ currIdx) ih.left)
          (nat_lt_add_assoc ih.right)

/-- Lemma 2: The value located at the returned index equals the search target. -/
def searchAux_get : ∀ (l : List Nat) (target currIdx idx : Nat),
    searchAux l target currIdx = Result.ok idx →
    l.get? (idx - currIdx) = Some target
  | [], _, _, _, h => nomatch h
  | x :: xs, target, currIdx, idx =>
    match hdec : x == target with
    | true =>
      fun h =>
        match h with
        | rfl =>
          have hx : x = target := nat_eq_of_beq_true x target hdec
          have h_head : (x :: xs).get? 0 = Some target := congrArg Some hx
          h_head
    | false =>
      fun h =>
        have hb := searchAux_bounds xs target (currIdx + 1) idx h
        have ih := searchAux_get xs target (currIdx + 1) idx h
        have h_sub : idx - currIdx = (idx - (currIdx + 1)) + 1 :=
          nat_sub_succ_eq currIdx idx hb.left
        have h_get : (x :: xs).get? ((idx - (currIdx + 1)) + 1) = xs.get? (idx - (currIdx + 1)) := rfl
        Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (x :: xs).get? p = Some target) (Eq.symm h_sub))
          (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => p = Some target) (Eq.symm h_get)) ih)

    searchAux l target currIdx = Result.ok idx →
    currIdx ≤ j →
    j < idx →
    l.get? (j - currIdx) = Some target → False
  | [], _, _, _, _, h, _, _, _ => nomatch h
  | x :: xs, target, currIdx, idx, j =>
    match hdec : x == target with
    | true =>
      fun h hj1 hj2 _ =>
        match h with
        | rfl =>
          have h_lt : currIdx < currIdx := nat_le_trans (nat_succ_le_succ hj1) hj2
          nat_lt_irrefl currIdx h_lt
    | false =>
      fun h hj1 hj2 hget =>
        match hjdec : j == currIdx with
        | true =>
          have hj_eq : j = currIdx := nat_eq_of_beq_true j currIdx hjdec
          have h_sub : j - currIdx = 0 :=
            match hj_eq with
            | rfl => rfl
          have h_some : Some x = Some target :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (x :: xs).get? p = Some target) h_sub) hget
          have hx_eq : x = target :=
            match h_some with
            | rfl => rfl
          have hx_true : (x == target) = true :=
            match hx_eq with
            | rfl => nat_beq_refl x
          nat_ne_of_beq_false (x == target) true hdec hx_true
        | false =>
          have hj_succ : currIdx + 1 ≤ j := nat_succ_le_of_le_and_ne hj1 hjdec
          have h_sub : j - currIdx = (j - (currIdx + 1)) + 1 :=
            nat_sub_succ_eq currIdx j hj_succ
          have h_get_tail : (x :: xs).get? ((j - (currIdx + 1)) + 1) = xs.get? (j - (currIdx + 1)) := rfl
          have h_xs_get : xs.get? (j - (currIdx + 1)) = Some target :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => p = Some target) h_get_tail)
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (x :: xs).get? p = Some target) h_sub) hget)
          searchAux_first xs target (currIdx + 1) idx j h hj_succ hj2 h_xs_get

/-- Lemma 4: NotFound error soundness—if NotFound is returned, target does not exist in search range. -/
def searchAux_notFound : ∀ (l : List Nat) (target currIdx j : Nat),
    searchAux l target currIdx = Result.err ZigError.NotFound →
    currIdx ≤ j →
    j < currIdx + l.length →
    l.get? (j - currIdx) = Some target → False
  | [], _, currIdx, j, h, hj1, hj2, _ =>
    have h_lt : currIdx < currIdx := nat_lt_of_lt_zero_add hj2
    have h_lt2 : currIdx < currIdx := nat_le_trans (nat_succ_le_succ hj1) h_lt
    nat_lt_irrefl currIdx h_lt2
  | x :: xs, target, currIdx, j =>
    match hdec : x == target with
    | true =>
      fun h => nomatch h
    | false =>
      fun h hj1 hj2 hget =>
        match hjdec : j == currIdx with
        | true =>
          have hj_eq : j = currIdx := nat_eq_of_beq_true j currIdx hjdec
          have h_sub : j - currIdx = 0 :=
            match hj_eq with
            | rfl => rfl
          have h_some : Some x = Some target :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (x :: xs).get? p = Some target) h_sub) hget
          have hx_eq : x = target :=
            match h_some with
            | rfl => rfl
          have hx_true : (x == target) = true :=
            match hx_eq with
            | rfl => nat_beq_refl x
          nat_ne_of_beq_false (x == target) true hdec hx_true
        | false =>
          have hj_succ : currIdx + 1 ≤ j := nat_succ_le_of_le_and_ne hj1 hjdec
          have hj2_assoc : j < (currIdx + 1) + xs.length :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (Nat.le (j + 1)) (nat_add_right_succ currIdx xs.length)) hj2
          have h_sub : j - currIdx = (j - (currIdx + 1)) + 1 :=
            nat_sub_succ_eq currIdx j hj_succ
          have h_get_tail : (x :: xs).get? ((j - (currIdx + 1)) + 1) = xs.get? (j - (currIdx + 1)) := rfl
          have h_xs_get : xs.get? (j - (currIdx + 1)) = Some target :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => p = Some target) h_get_tail)
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (x :: xs).get? p = Some target) h_sub) hget)
          searchAux_notFound xs target (currIdx + 1) j h hj_succ hj2_assoc h_xs_get

/-- Lemma 5: Completeness—if target is in slice, search algorithm finds an index `idx ≤ k`. -/
def searchAux_complete : ∀ (l : List Nat) (target currIdx k : Nat),
    currIdx ≤ k →
    k < currIdx + l.length →
    l.get? (k - currIdx) = Some target →
    Σ idx, searchAux l target currIdx = Result.ok idx ∧ idx ≤ k
  | [], _, currIdx, k, hk1, hk2, _ =>
    have h_lt : currIdx < currIdx := nat_lt_of_lt_zero_add hk2
    have h_lt2 : currIdx < currIdx := nat_le_trans (nat_succ_le_succ hk1) h_lt
    False.elim (nat_lt_irrefl currIdx h_lt2)
  | x :: xs, target, currIdx, k =>
    match hdec : x == target with
    | true =>
      fun hk1 _ _ =>
        Sigma.mk currIdx (And.intro rfl hk1)
    | false =>
      fun hk1 hk2 hget =>
        match hkdec : k == currIdx with
        | true =>
          have hk_eq : k = currIdx := nat_eq_of_beq_true k currIdx hkdec
          have h_sub : k - currIdx = 0 :=
            match hk_eq with
            | rfl => rfl
          have h_some : Some x = Some target :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (x :: xs).get? p = Some target) h_sub) hget
          have hx_eq : x = target :=
            match h_some with
            | rfl => rfl
          have hx_true : (x == target) = true :=
            match hx_eq with
            | rfl => nat_beq_refl x
          False.elim (nat_ne_of_beq_false (x == target) true hdec hx_true)
        | false =>
          have hk_succ : currIdx + 1 ≤ k := nat_succ_le_of_le_and_ne hk1 hkdec
          have hk2_assoc : k < (currIdx + 1) + xs.length :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (Nat.le (k + 1)) (nat_add_right_succ currIdx xs.length)) hk2
          have h_sub : k - currIdx = (k - (currIdx + 1)) + 1 :=
            nat_sub_succ_eq currIdx k hk_succ
          have h_get_tail : (x :: xs).get? ((k - (currIdx + 1)) + 1) = xs.get? (k - (currIdx + 1)) := rfl
          have h_xs_get : xs.get? (k - (currIdx + 1)) = Some target :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => p = Some target) h_get_tail)
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (x :: xs).get? p = Some target) h_sub) hget)
          searchAux_complete xs target (currIdx + 1) k hk_succ hk2_assoc h_xs_get


-- ============================================================================
-- 5. TOP-LEVEL THEOREMS & MASTER SPECIFICATION FOR ZIG LINEAR SEARCH
-- ============================================================================

/-- Theorem 1 (Found Soundness): Returning `ok idx` guarantees `idx` is valid and holds `target`. -/
theorem zigLinearSearch_soundness (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target idx : Nat)
    (h : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.ok idx) :
    idx < s.elements.length ∧ s.elements.get? idx = Some target :=
  have hb := searchAux_bounds s.elements target 0 idx h
  have hg := searchAux_get s.elements target 0 idx h
  And.intro (nat_lt_of_lt_zero_add hb.right) hg

/-- Theorem 2 (First Occurrence): No smaller index contains the search target. -/
theorem zigLinearSearch_first (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target idx j : Nat)
    (h : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.ok idx)
    (hj : j < idx) :
    s.elements.get? j ≠ Some target :=
  fun hget =>
    searchAux_first s.elements target 0 idx j h (nat_zero_le j) hj hget

/-- Theorem 3 (NotFound Soundness): Returning `err NotFound` proves target is not in the slice. -/
theorem zigLinearSearch_notFound_sound (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target j : Nat)
    (h : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.err ZigError.NotFound)
    (hj : j < s.elements.length) :
    s.elements.get? j ≠ Some target :=
  fun hget =>
    searchAux_notFound s.elements target 0 j h (nat_zero_le j) (nat_lt_zero_add hj) hget

/-- Theorem 4 (Completeness): If target is in the slice, search always succeeds. -/
theorem zigLinearSearch_completeness (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target k : Nat)
    (hk : k < s.elements.length)
    (hget : s.elements.get? k = Some target) :
    Σ idx, zigLinearSearch s target = Result.ok idx ∧ idx ≤ k :=
  searchAux_complete s.elements target 0 k (nat_zero_le k) (nat_lt_zero_add hk) hget

/-- Master Theorem: The Zig function `zigLinearSearch` returns `ok idx` IF AND ONLY IF `idx` is
    a valid bound, `slice[idx] == target`, and `idx` is the minimal matching index. -/
theorem zigLinearSearch_correctness (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target : Nat) (idx : Nat) :
    zigLinearSearch s target = Result.ok idx ↔
    (idx < s.elements.length ∧ s.elements.get? idx = Some target ∧ ∀ j, j < idx → s.elements.get? j ≠ Some target) :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun h =>
      have hsound := zigLinearSearch_soundness s target idx h
      have hfirst := fun j hj => zigLinearSearch_first s target idx j h hj
      And.intro hsound.left (And.intro hsound.right hfirst))
    (fun hspec =>
      have ⟨hbound, hget, hfirst⟩ := hspec
      have ⟨idx', ⟨hok', hle'⟩⟩ := zigLinearSearch_completeness s target idx hbound hget
      have hdec : idx' = idx :=
        match h_cmp : idx' == idx with
        | true => nat_eq_of_beq_true idx' idx h_cmp
        | false =>
          have hlt : idx' < idx := nat_succ_le_of_le_and_ne hle' h_cmp
          have hbad : s.elements.get? idx' ≠ Some target := hfirst idx' hlt
          have hgood : s.elements.get? idx' = Some target := (zigLinearSearch_soundness s target idx' hok').right
          False.elim (hbad hgood)
      match hdec with
      | rfl => hok')

end ZigVerification

/-- Theorem 1 (Found Soundness): Returning `ok idx` guarantees `idx` is valid and holds `target`. -/
theorem zigLinearSearch_soundness (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target idx : Nat)
    (h : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.ok idx) :
    idx < s.elements.length ∧ s.elements.get? idx = Some target :=
  have hb := searchAux_bounds s.elements target 0 idx h
  have hg := searchAux_get s.elements target 0 idx h
  And.intro (nat_lt_of_lt_zero_add hb.right) hg

theorem zigLinearSearch_first (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target idx j : Nat)
    (h : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.ok idx)
    (hj : j < idx) :
    s.elements.get? j ≠ Some target :=
  fun hget =>
    searchAux_first s.elements target 0 idx j h (nat_zero_le j) hj hget

/-- Theorem 3 (NotFound Soundness): Returning `err NotFound` proves target is not in the slice. -/
theorem zigLinearSearch_notFound_sound (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target j : Nat)
    (h : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.err ZigError.NotFound)
    (hj : j < s.elements.length) :
    s.elements.get? j ≠ Some target :=

    searchAux_notFound s.elements target 0 j h (nat_zero_le j) (nat_lt_zero_add hj) hget

theorem zigLinearSearch_completeness (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target k : Nat)
    (hk : k < s.elements.length)
    (hget : s.elements.get? k = Some target) :
    Σ idx, zigLinearSearch s target = Result.ok idx ∧ idx ≤ k :=

/-- Master Theorem: The Zig function `zigLinearSearch` returns `ok idx` IF AND ONLY IF `idx` is

theorem zigLinearSearch_correctness (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target : Nat) (idx : Nat) :
    zigLinearSearch s target = Result.ok idx ↔
    (idx < s.elements.length ∧ s.elements.get? idx = Some target ∧ ∀ j, j < idx → s.elements.get? j ≠ Some target) :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun h =>
      have hsound := zigLinearSearch_soundness s target idx h
      have hfirst := fun j hj => zigLinearSearch_first s target idx j h hj
      And.intro hsound.left (And.intro hsound.right hfirst))
    (fun hspec =>
      have ⟨hbound, hget, hfirst⟩ := hspec
      have ⟨idx', ⟨hok', hle'⟩⟩ := zigLinearSearch_completeness s target idx hbound hget
      have hdec : idx' = idx :=

        | true => nat_eq_of_beq_true idx' idx h_cmp
        | false =>

          have hbad : s.elements.get? idx' ≠ Some target := hfirst idx' hlt
          have hgood : s.elements.get? idx' = Some target := (zigLinearSearch_soundness s target idx' hok').right
          False.elim (hbad hgood)
      match hdec with
      | rfl => hok')

## Tiltott elemek

Pozitívum, hogy a fájlban továbbra sem látok `by`, `sorry`, `admit`, `Classical.*`, `Decidable.em` vagy `native_decide` használatot. Ez viszont csak a minimális szintaktikai feltétel; Lean-ben a tényleges elfogadhatóságot az adja, hogy a deklarációk valóban elaborálnak, és a `#print axioms` csak a már sikeresen létrejött deklarációk axiómafüggéseit tudja érdemben megmutatni.[1]

## Biztos fordítási hibák

A legsúlyosabb hiba az, hogy több helyen így bontasz esetet: `match hdec : s.elements.length > MAX_USIZE with | true => ... | false => ...`; ez típushibás, mert a diszkrimináns itt egy Proposition, míg a `true` és `false` minták Bool-konstruktorok, és a pattern matchingben a minták típusának illeszkednie kell a diszkrimináns típusához [2]. Prop-alapú elágazáshoz term-módban az `if h : c then ... else ...` forma való, nem a Bool-mintás `match` [3].

A másik biztos parserhiba a `match hdec confused with` sor a `zigLinearSearch_completeness` tételben. A `confused` itt nem Lean-szintaxis, tehát ez önmagában elég ahhoz, hogy a fájl ne menjen végig a parseren.

## Bizonyítási hibák

      False.elim (nat_lt_irrefl MAX_USIZE hbad)
    else

        zigLinearSearch_no_overflow_eq s target hdec

  Sigma.mk idx (And.intro h_search hle)

  Iff.intro
    (fun h =>
      have hsound := zigLinearSearch_soundness s target idx h
      have hfirst := fun j hj => zigLinearSearch_first s target idx j h hj
      And.intro hsound.left (And.intro hsound.right hfirst))
    (fun hspec =>
      have ⟨hbound, hget, hfirst⟩ := hspec
      have ⟨idx', ⟨hok', hle'⟩⟩ := zigLinearSearch_completeness s target idx hno_overflow hbound hget
      have hdec : idx' = idx :=

        | true => nat_eq_of_beq_true idx' idx h_cmp

          have hgood : zigGet s idx' = Result.ok target := (zigLinearSearch_soundness s target idx' hok').right

      match hdec with
      | rfl => hok')

      have hget_res := h_sound_nat.right

      have hget : (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? idx.val = Some target.val :=
        Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? p = Some target.val) h_idx_eq) hget_some
      And.intro hlen hget
    else
      nomatch h
  | Result.err e => nomatch h

  | 0, _ + 1, _ => rfl
  | currIdx + 1, idx + 1, h => nat_sub_succ_eq currIdx idx (nat_le_of_succ_le_succ h)

def nat_succ_le_of_le_and_ne : ∀ {a b : Nat}, a ≤ b → (b == a) = false → a + 1 ≤ b
  | 0, 0, _, hne => False.elim (false_ne_true (Eq.symm hne))
  | 0, b + 1, _, _ => nat_succ_le_succ (nat_zero_le b)
  | a + 1, b + 1, hle, hne => nat_succ_le_succ (nat_succ_le_of_le_and_ne (nat_le_of_succ_le_succ hle) hne)

def nat_lt_irrefl : ∀ (n : Nat), n < n → False
  | 0, h => nomatch h
  | n + 1, h =>
    have h' : n < n := nat_le_of_succ_le_succ h
    nat_lt_irrefl n h'

def nat_zero_add : ∀ (n : Nat), 0 + n = n
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => congrArg Nat.succ (nat_zero_add n)

def nat_lt_of_lt_zero_add {idx len : Nat} (h : idx < 0 + len) : idx < len :=
  Eq.mp (congrArg (fun t => idx + 1 ≤ t) (nat_zero_add len)) h

def nat_lt_zero_add {idx len : Nat} (h : idx < len) : idx < 0 + len :=
  Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun t => idx + 1 ≤ t) (nat_zero_add len)) h

def searchAux_bounds : ∀ (l : List Nat) (target currIdx idx : Nat),
    searchAux l target currIdx = Result.ok idx →
    currIdx ≤ idx ∧ idx < currIdx + l.length
  | [], _, _, _, h => nomatch h
  | x :: xs, target, currIdx, idx =>
    match hdec : x == target with
    | true =>
      fun h =>
        match h with
        | rfl =>
          And.intro
            (nat_le_refl currIdx)
            (nat_lt_add_succ currIdx xs.length)
    | false =>
      fun h =>
        have ih := searchAux_bounds xs target (currIdx + 1) idx h
        And.intro
          (nat_le_trans (nat_le_succ currIdx) ih.left)
          (nat_lt_add_assoc ih.right)

def searchAux_get : ∀ (l : List Nat) (target currIdx idx : Nat),
    searchAux l target currIdx = Result.ok idx →
    l.get? (idx - currIdx) = Some target
  | [], _, _, _, h => nomatch h
  | x :: xs, target, currIdx, idx =>
    match hdec : x == target with
    | true =>
      fun h =>
        match h with
        | rfl =>
          have hx : x = target := nat_eq_of_beq_true x target hdec
          have h_head : (x :: xs).get? 0 = Some target := congrArg Some hx
          h_head
    | false =>
      fun h =>
        have hb := searchAux_bounds xs target (currIdx + 1) idx h
        have ih := searchAux_get xs target (currIdx + 1) idx h
        have h_sub : idx - currIdx = (idx - (currIdx + 1)) + 1 :=
          nat_sub_succ_eq currIdx idx hb.left
        have h_get : (x :: xs).get? ((idx - (currIdx + 1)) + 1) = xs.get? (idx - (currIdx + 1)) := rfl
        Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (x :: xs).get? p = Some target) (Eq.symm h_sub))
          (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => p = Some target) (Eq.symm h_get)) ih)

def searchAux_first : ∀ (l : List Nat) (target currIdx idx j : Nat),
    searchAux l target currIdx = Result.ok idx →
    currIdx ≤ j →
    j < idx →
    l.get? (j - currIdx) = Some target → False
  | [], _, _, _, _, h, _, _, _ => nomatch h
  | x :: xs, target, currIdx, idx, j =>
    match hdec : x == target with
    | true =>
      fun h hj1 hj2 _ =>
        match h with
        | rfl =>
          have h_lt : currIdx < currIdx := nat_le_trans (nat_succ_le_succ hj1) hj2
          nat_lt_irrefl currIdx h_lt
    | false =>
      fun h hj1 hj2 hget =>
        match hjdec : j == currIdx with
        | true =>
          have hj_eq : j = currIdx := nat_eq_of_beq_true j currIdx hjdec
          have h_sub : j - currIdx = 0 :=
            match hj_eq with
            | rfl => rfl
          have h_some : Some x = Some target :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (x :: xs).get? p = Some target) h_sub) hget
          have hx_eq : x = target :=
            match h_some with
            | rfl => rfl
          have hx_true : (x == target) = true :=
            match hx_eq with
            | rfl => nat_beq_refl x
          have hcontra : false = true := Eq.trans (Eq.symm hdec) hx_true
          False.elim (false_ne_true hcontra)
        | false =>
          have hj_succ : currIdx + 1 ≤ j := nat_succ_le_of_le_and_ne hj1 hjdec
          have h_sub : j - currIdx = (j - (currIdx + 1)) + 1 :=
            nat_sub_succ_eq currIdx j hj_succ
          have h_get_tail : (x :: xs).get? ((j - (currIdx + 1)) + 1) = xs.get? (j - (currIdx + 1)) := rfl
          have h_xs_get : xs.get? (j - (currIdx + 1)) = Some target :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => p = Some target) h_get_tail)
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (x :: xs).get? p = Some target) h_sub) hget)
          searchAux_first xs target (currIdx + 1) idx j h hj_succ hj2 h_xs_get

def searchAux_notFound : ∀ (l : List Nat) (target currIdx j : Nat),
    searchAux l target currIdx = Result.err ZigError.NotFound →
    currIdx ≤ j →
    j < currIdx + l.length →
    l.get? (j - currIdx) = Some target → False
  | [], _, currIdx, j, h, hj1, hj2, _ =>
    have h_lt : currIdx < currIdx := nat_lt_of_lt_zero_add hj2
    have h_lt2 : currIdx < currIdx := nat_le_trans (nat_succ_le_succ hj1) h_lt
    nat_lt_irrefl currIdx h_lt2
  | x :: xs, target, currIdx, j =>
    match hdec : x == target with
    | true =>
      fun h => nomatch h
    | false =>
      fun h hj1 hj2 hget =>
        match hjdec : j == currIdx with
        | true =>
          have hj_eq : j = currIdx := nat_eq_of_beq_true j currIdx hjdec
          have h_sub : j - currIdx = 0 :=
            match hj_eq with
            | rfl => rfl
          have h_some : Some x = Some target :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (x :: xs).get? p = Some target) h_sub) hget
          have hx_eq : x = target :=
            match h_some with
            | rfl => rfl
          have hx_true : (x == target) = true :=
            match hx_eq with
            | rfl => nat_beq_refl x
          have hcontra : false = true := Eq.trans (Eq.symm hdec) hx_true
          False.elim (false_ne_true hcontra)
        | false =>
          have hj_succ : currIdx + 1 ≤ j := nat_succ_le_of_le_and_ne hj1 hjdec
          have hj2_assoc : j < (currIdx + 1) + xs.length :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun t => j + 1 ≤ t) (nat_add_right_succ currIdx xs.length)) hj2
          have h_sub : j - currIdx = (j - (currIdx + 1)) + 1 :=
            nat_sub_succ_eq currIdx j hj_succ
          have h_get_tail : (x :: xs).get? ((j - (currIdx + 1)) + 1) = xs.get? (j - (currIdx + 1)) := rfl
          have h_xs_get : xs.get? (j - (currIdx + 1)) = Some target :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => p = Some target) h_get_tail)
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (x :: xs).get? p = Some target) h_sub) hget)
          searchAux_notFound xs target (currIdx + 1) j h hj_succ hj2_assoc h_xs_get

def searchAux_complete : ∀ (l : List Nat) (target currIdx k : Nat),
    currIdx ≤ k →
    k < currIdx + l.length →
    l.get? (k - currIdx) = Some target →
    Σ idx, searchAux l target currIdx = Result.ok idx ∧ idx ≤ k
  | [], _, currIdx, k, hk1, hk2, _ =>
    have h_lt : currIdx < currIdx := nat_lt_of_lt_zero_add hk2
    have h_lt2 : currIdx < currIdx := nat_le_trans (nat_succ_le_succ hk1) h_lt
    False.elim (nat_lt_irrefl currIdx h_lt2)
  | x :: xs, target, currIdx, k =>
    match hdec : x == target with
    | true =>
      fun hk1 _ _ =>
        Sigma.mk currIdx (And.intro rfl hk1)
    | false =>
      fun hk1 hk2 hget =>
        match hkdec : k == currIdx with
        | true =>
          have hk_eq : k = currIdx := nat_eq_of_beq_true k currIdx hkdec
          have h_sub : k - currIdx = 0 :=
            match hk_eq with
            | rfl => rfl
          have h_some : Some x = Some target :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (x :: xs).get? p = Some target) h_sub) hget
          have hx_eq : x = target :=
            match h_some with
            | rfl => rfl
          have hx_true : (x == target) = true :=
            match hx_eq with
            | rfl => nat_beq_refl x
          have hcontra : false = true := Eq.trans (Eq.symm hdec) hx_true
          False.elim (false_ne_true hcontra)
        | false =>
          have hk_succ : currIdx + 1 ≤ k := nat_succ_le_of_le_and_ne hk1 hkdec
          have hk2_assoc : k < (currIdx + 1) + xs.length :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun t => k + 1 ≤ t) (nat_add_right_succ currIdx xs.length)) hk2
          have h_sub : k - currIdx = (k - (currIdx + 1)) + 1 :=
            nat_sub_succ_eq currIdx k hk_succ
          have h_get_tail : (x :: xs).get? ((k - (currIdx + 1)) + 1) = xs.get? (k - (currIdx + 1)) := rfl
          have h_xs_get : xs.get? (k - (currIdx + 1)) = Some target :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => p = Some target) h_get_tail)
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (x :: xs).get? p = Some target) h_sub) hget)
          searchAux_complete xs target (currIdx + 1) k hk_succ hk2_assoc h_xs_get

theorem zigLen_eq_length (s : ZigSlice Nat) :
    zigLen s = s.elements.length := rfl

theorem zigGet_ok_iff (s : ZigSlice Nat) (i : Nat) (v : Nat) :
    zigGet s i = Result.ok v ↔ s.elements.get? i = Some v :=
  match h : s.elements.get? i with
  | Some x =>
    Iff.intro
      (fun hg =>
        match hg with
        | rfl => h)
      (fun hspec =>
        match hspec with
        | rfl => rfl)
  | None =>
    Iff.intro
      (fun hg => nomatch hg)
      (fun hspec => nomatch (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h) hspec))

theorem zigLinearSearch_overflow_eq (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target : Nat)
    (h : s.elements.length > MAX_USIZE) :
    zigLinearSearch s target = Result.err ZigError.Overflow :=
  if hdec : s.elements.length > MAX_USIZE then
    rfl
  else
    False.elim (hdec h)

theorem zigLinearSearch_no_overflow_eq (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target : Nat)
    (h : ¬ (s.elements.length > MAX_USIZE)) :
    zigLinearSearch s target = searchAux s.elements target 0 :=
  if hdec : s.elements.length > MAX_USIZE then
    False.elim (h hdec)
  else
    rfl

theorem search_no_overflow_of_ok (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target idx : Nat)
    (h : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.ok idx) :
    searchAux s.elements target 0 = Result.ok idx :=
  if hov : s.elements.length > MAX_USIZE then
    have h_err : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.err ZigError.Overflow :=
      zigLinearSearch_overflow_eq s target hov
    have h_contra : Result.err ZigError.Overflow = Result.ok idx :=
      Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_err) h
    nomatch h_contra
  else
    have h_eq : zigLinearSearch s target = searchAux s.elements target 0 :=
      zigLinearSearch_no_overflow_eq s target hov
    Eq.mp (congrArg (fun f => f = Result.ok idx) h_eq) h

theorem search_no_overflow_of_notFound (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target : Nat)
    (h : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.err ZigError.NotFound) :
    searchAux s.elements target 0 = Result.err ZigError.NotFound :=
  if hov : s.elements.length > MAX_USIZE then
    have h_err : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.err ZigError.Overflow :=
      zigLinearSearch_overflow_eq s target hov
    have h_contra : Result.err ZigError.Overflow = Result.err ZigError.NotFound :=
      Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_err) h
    nomatch h_contra
  else
    have h_eq : zigLinearSearch s target = searchAux s.elements target 0 :=
      zigLinearSearch_no_overflow_eq s target hov
    Eq.mp (congrArg (fun f => f = Result.err ZigError.NotFound) h_eq) h

theorem zigLinearSearch_soundness (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target idx : Nat)
    (h : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.ok idx) :
    idx < zigLen s ∧ zigGet s idx = Result.ok target :=
  have h_aux := search_no_overflow_of_ok s target idx h
  have hb := searchAux_bounds s.elements target 0 idx h_aux
  have hg := searchAux_get s.elements target 0 idx h_aux
  have hlen : idx < zigLen s := nat_lt_of_lt_zero_add hb.right
  have hget : zigGet s idx = Result.ok target := (zigGet_ok_iff s idx target).mpr hg
  And.intro hlen hget

theorem zigLinearSearch_first (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target idx j : Nat)
    (h : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.ok idx)
    (hj : j < idx) :
    zigGet s j ≠ Result.ok target :=
  have h_aux := search_no_overflow_of_ok s target idx h
  fun hget =>
    have hget_elem : s.elements.get? j = Some target := (zigGet_ok_iff s j target).mp hget
    searchAux_first s.elements target 0 idx j h_aux (nat_zero_le j) hj hget_elem

theorem zigLinearSearch_notFound_sound (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target j : Nat)
    (h : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.err ZigError.NotFound)
    (hj : j < zigLen s) :
    zigGet s j ≠ Result.ok target :=
  have h_aux := search_no_overflow_of_notFound s target h
  fun hget =>
    have hget_elem : s.elements.get? j = Some target := (zigGet_ok_iff s j target).mp hget
    searchAux_notFound s.elements target 0 j h_aux (nat_zero_le j) (nat_lt_zero_add hj) hget_elem

theorem zigLinearSearch_completeness (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target k : Nat)
    (hno_overflow : zigLen s ≤ MAX_USIZE)
    (hk : k < zigLen s)
    (hget : zigGet s k = Result.ok target) :
    Σ idx, zigLinearSearch s target = Result.ok idx ∧ idx ≤ k :=
  have hget_elem : s.elements.get? k = Some target := (zigGet_ok_iff s k target).mp hget
  have ⟨idx, h_aux, hle⟩ := searchAux_complete s.elements target 0 k (nat_zero_le k) (nat_lt_zero_add hk) hget_elem
  have h_search : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.ok idx :=
    if hdec : s.elements.length > MAX_USIZE then
      have hbad : MAX_USIZE < MAX_USIZE := nat_le_trans hdec hno_overflow
      False.elim (nat_lt_irrefl MAX_USIZE hbad)
    else
      have h_eq : zigLinearSearch s target = searchAux s.elements target 0 :=
        zigLinearSearch_no_overflow_eq s target hdec
      Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun f => f = Result.ok idx) h_eq) h_aux
  Sigma.mk idx (And.intro h_search hle)

theorem zigLinearSearch_correctness (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target : Nat) (idx : Nat)
    (hno_overflow : zigLen s ≤ MAX_USIZE) :
    zigLinearSearch s target = Result.ok idx ↔
    (idx < zigLen s ∧ zigGet s idx = Result.ok target ∧ ∀ j, j < idx → zigGet s j ≠ Result.ok target) :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun h =>
      have hsound := zigLinearSearch_soundness s target idx h
      have hfirst := fun j hj => zigLinearSearch_first s target idx j h hj
      And.intro hsound.left (And.intro hsound.right hfirst))
    (fun hspec =>
      have ⟨hbound, hget, hfirst⟩ := hspec
      have ⟨idx', ⟨hok', hle'⟩⟩ := zigLinearSearch_completeness s target idx hno_overflow hbound hget
      have hdec : idx' = idx :=
        match h_cmp : idx' == idx with
        | true => nat_eq_of_beq_true idx' idx h_cmp
        | false =>
          have hlt : idx' < idx := nat_succ_le_of_le_and_ne hle' h_cmp
          have hbad : zigGet s idx' ≠ Result.ok target := hfirst idx' hlt
          have hgood : zigGet s idx' = Result.ok target := (zigLinearSearch_soundness s target idx' hok').right
          False.elim (hbad hgood)
      match hdec with
      | rfl => hok')

def eraseU32 (x : U32) : Nat := x.val

def eraseSliceU32 (s : ZigSliceU32) : ZigSlice Nat :=
  ⟨s.elements.map eraseU32⟩

def zigLenU32 (s : ZigSliceU32) : Nat :=
  s.elements.length

def zigGetU32 (s : ZigSliceU32) (idx : Nat) : Result ZigError U32 :=
  match s.elements.get? idx with
  | Some v => Result.ok v
  | None => Result.err ZigError.IndexOutOfBounds

def wrap_idx (idx : Nat) : Result ZigError USize :=
  match Nat.decLe idx MAX_USIZE with
  | isTrue h => Result.ok ⟨idx, h⟩
  | isFalse _ => Result.err ZigError.Overflow

def zigLinearSearchU32 (s : ZigSliceU32) (target : U32) : Result ZigError USize :=
  match zigLinearSearch (eraseSliceU32 s) target.val with
  | Result.ok idx => wrap_idx idx
  | Result.err e => Result.err e

def list_get_map {α β : Type} (f : α → β) : ∀ (l : List α) (i : Nat),
    (l.map f).get? i = match l.get? i with | Some x => Some (f x) | None => None
  | [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, 0 => rfl
  | _ :: xs, i + 1 => list_get_map f xs i

def list_length_map {α β : Type} (f : α → β) : ∀ (l : List α),
    (l.map f).length = l.length
  | [] => rfl
  | _ :: xs => congrArg Nat.succ (list_length_map f xs)

theorem eraseSlice_length (s : ZigSliceU32) :
    (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.length = zigLenU32 s :=
  list_length_map eraseU32 s.elements

theorem eraseSlice_get (s : ZigSliceU32) (i : Nat) :
    (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i = match s.elements.get? i with
                                        | Some v => Some v.val
                                        | None => None :=
  list_get_map eraseU32 s.elements i

theorem zigGetU32_ok_iff (s : ZigSliceU32) (i : Nat) (v : U32) :
    zigGetU32 s i = Result.ok v ↔ (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i = Some v.val :=
  have h_get_map : (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i =
    (match s.elements.get? i with | Some x => Some x.val | None => None) := eraseSlice_get s i
  match h : s.elements.get? i with
  | Some x =>
    have heq1 : zigGetU32 s i = Result.ok x :=
      Eq.mp (congrArg (fun opt => (match opt with | Some y => Result.ok y | None => Result.err ZigError.IndexOutOfBounds) = Result.ok x) (Eq.symm h)) rfl
    have heq2 : (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i = Some x.val :=
      Eq.mp (congrArg (fun opt => (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i = (match opt with | Some y => Some y.val | None => None)) (Eq.symm h)) h_get_map
    Iff.intro
      (fun h_ok =>
         have h_contra : Result.ok x = Result.ok v := Eq.trans (Eq.symm heq1) h_ok
         have hx_eq_v : x = v := match h_contra with | rfl => rfl
         Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun p => (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i = Some p.val) hx_eq_v) heq2)
      (fun h_some =>
         have h_eq : Some x.val = Some v.val := Eq.trans (Eq.symm heq2) h_some
         have hx_val_eq_v_val : x.val = v.val := match h_eq with | rfl => rfl
         have hx_eq_v : x = v := Subtype.eq hx_val_eq_v_val
         Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun p => zigGetU32 s i = Result.ok p) hx_eq_v) heq1)
  | None =>
    have heq1 : zigGetU32 s i = Result.err ZigError.IndexOutOfBounds :=
      Eq.mp (congrArg (fun opt => (match opt with | Some y => Result.ok y | None => Result.err ZigError.IndexOutOfBounds) = Result.err ZigError.IndexOutOfBounds) (Eq.symm h)) rfl
    have heq2 : (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i = None :=
      Eq.mp (congrArg (fun opt => (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i = (match opt with | Some y => Some y.val | None => None)) (Eq.symm h)) h_get_map
    Iff.intro
      (fun h_ok =>
         have h_contra : Result.err ZigError.IndexOutOfBounds = Result.ok v := Eq.trans (Eq.symm heq1) h_ok
         nomatch h_contra)
      (fun h_some =>
         have h_contra : None = Some v.val := Eq.trans (Eq.symm heq2) h_some
         nomatch h_contra)

def wrap_idx_ok_fn (idx : Nat) (idx_u : USize) (d : Decidable (idx ≤ MAX_USIZE)) : Prop :=
  (match d with
   | isTrue h => Result.ok (⟨idx, h⟩ : USize)
   | isFalse _ => Result.err ZigError.Overflow) = Result.ok idx_u

theorem wrap_idx_ok (idx : Nat) (idx_u : USize) (h : wrap_idx idx = Result.ok idx_u) :
    idx = idx_u.val :=
  match hdec : Nat.decLe idx MAX_USIZE with
  | isTrue hbound =>
    have h_match : wrap_idx_ok_fn idx idx_u (isTrue hbound) :=
      Eq.mp (congrArg (wrap_idx_ok_fn idx idx_u) hdec) h
    have h_eq : Result.ok (⟨idx, hbound⟩ : USize) = Result.ok idx_u := h_match
    have h_inner : (⟨idx, hbound⟩ : USize) = idx_u :=
      match h_eq with | rfl => rfl
    congrArg Subtype.val h_inner
  | isFalse hfalse =>
    have h_match : wrap_idx_ok_fn idx idx_u (isFalse hfalse) :=
      Eq.mp (congrArg (wrap_idx_ok_fn idx idx_u) hdec) h
    have h_contra : Result.err ZigError.Overflow = Result.ok idx_u := h_match
    nomatch h_contra

def unwrap_ok_fn (s : ZigSliceU32) (target : U32) (idx_u : USize) (r : Result ZigError Nat) : Prop :=
  (match r with
   | Result.ok idx => wrap_idx idx
   | Result.err e => Result.err e) = Result.ok idx_u

theorem zigLinearSearchU32_unwrap_ok (s : ZigSliceU32) (target : U32) (idx : USize)
    (h : zigLinearSearchU32 s target = Result.ok idx) :
    zigLinearSearch (eraseSliceU32 s) target.val = Result.ok idx.val :=
  match hr : zigLinearSearch (eraseSliceU32 s) target.val with
  | Result.ok idx_nat =>
    have h_match : unwrap_ok_fn s target idx (Result.ok idx_nat) :=
      Eq.mp (congrArg (unwrap_ok_fn s target idx) hr) h
    have h_wrap : wrap_idx idx_nat = Result.ok idx := h_match
    have h_idx_eq : idx_nat = idx.val := wrap_idx_ok idx_nat idx h_wrap
    Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun p => p = Result.ok idx.val) hr) (congrArg Result.ok h_idx_eq)
  | Result.err e =>
    have h_match : unwrap_ok_fn s target idx (Result.err e) :=
      Eq.mp (congrArg (unwrap_ok_fn s target idx) hr) h
    have h_contra : Result.err e = Result.ok idx := h_match
    nomatch h_contra

def unwrap_err_fn (s : ZigSliceU32) (target : U32) (err : ZigError) (r : Result ZigError Nat) : Prop :=
  (match r with
   | Result.ok idx => wrap_idx idx
   | Result.err e => Result.err e) = Result.err err

theorem zigLinearSearchU32_unwrap_notFound (s : ZigSliceU32) (target : U32)

  | b + 1 => congrArg Nat.succ (nat_add_right_succ a b)

def nat_lt_add_assoc {idx currIdx len : Nat} (h : idx < (currIdx + 1) + len) : idx < currIdx + (len + 1) :=
  Eq.mp (congrArg (fun t => idx + 1 ≤ t) (nat_add_right_succ currIdx len)) h

def nat_eq_of_beq_true : ∀ (a b : Nat), (a == b) = true → a = b
  | 0, 0, _ => rfl
  | 0, _ + 1, h => nomatch h
  | _ + 1, 0, h => nomatch h
  | a + 1, b + 1, h => congrArg Nat.succ (nat_eq_of_beq_true a b h)

def nat_beq_refl : ∀ (a : Nat), (a == a) = true
  | 0 => rfl
  | a + 1 => nat_beq_refl a

def nat_beq_symm : ∀ (a b : Nat), (a == b) = (b == a)
  | 0, 0 => rfl
  | 0, _ + 1 => rfl
  | _ + 1, 0 => rfl
  | a + 1, b + 1 => nat_beq_symm a b

def nat_sub_succ_eq : ∀ (currIdx idx : Nat), currIdx < idx → idx - currIdx = (idx - (currIdx + 1)) + 1
  | 0, 0, h => nomatch h
  | 0, _ + 1, _ => rfl
  | currIdx + 1, idx + 1, h => nat_sub_succ_eq currIdx idx (nat_le_of_succ_le_succ h)

def nat_succ_le_of_le_and_ne : ∀ {a b : Nat}, a ≤ b → (b == a) = false → a + 1 ≤ b
  | 0, 0, _, hne => False.elim (false_ne_true (Eq.symm hne))
  | 0, b + 1, _, _ => nat_succ_le_succ (nat_zero_le b)
  | a + 1, b + 1, hle, hne => nat_succ_le_succ (nat_succ_le_of_le_and_ne (nat_le_of_succ_le_succ hle) hne)

def nat_succ_le_of_le_and_ne_left : ∀ {a b : Nat}, a ≤ b → (a == b) = false → a + 1 ≤ b
  | a, b, hle, hne =>
    have hne' : (b == a) = false :=
      Eq.trans (Eq.symm (nat_beq_symm b a)) hne
    nat_succ_le_of_le_and_ne hle hne'

def nat_lt_irrefl : ∀ (n : Nat), n < n → False
  | 0, h => nomatch h
  | n + 1, h =>
    have h' : n < n := nat_le_of_succ_le_succ h
    nat_lt_irrefl n h'

def nat_zero_add : ∀ (n : Nat), 0 + n = n
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => congrArg Nat.succ (nat_zero_add n)

def nat_lt_of_lt_zero_add {idx len : Nat} (h : idx < 0 + len) : idx < len :=
  Eq.mp (congrArg (fun t => idx + 1 ≤ t) (nat_zero_add len)) h

def nat_lt_zero_add {idx len : Nat} (h : idx < len) : idx < 0 + len :=
  Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun t => idx + 1 ≤ t) (nat_zero_add len)) h

def nat_le_of_lt {a b : Nat} (h : a < b) : a ≤ b :=
  nat_le_trans (nat_le_succ a) h

def searchAux_bounds : ∀ (l : List Nat) (target currIdx idx : Nat),
    searchAux l target currIdx = Result.ok idx →
    currIdx ≤ idx ∧ idx < currIdx + l.length
  | [], _, _, _, h => nomatch h
  | x :: xs, target, currIdx, idx =>
    match hdec : x == target with
    | true =>
      fun h =>
        match h with
        | rfl =>
          And.intro
            (nat_le_refl currIdx)
            (nat_lt_add_succ currIdx xs.length)
    | false =>
      fun h =>
        have ih := searchAux_bounds xs target (currIdx + 1) idx h
        And.intro
          (nat_le_trans (nat_le_succ currIdx) ih.left)
          (nat_lt_add_assoc ih.right)

def searchAux_get : ∀ (l : List Nat) (target currIdx idx : Nat),
    searchAux l target currIdx = Result.ok idx →
    l.get? (idx - currIdx) = some target
  | [], _, _, _, h => nomatch h
  | x :: xs, target, currIdx, idx =>
    match hdec : x == target with
    | true =>
      fun h =>
        match h with
        | rfl =>
          have hx : x = target := nat_eq_of_beq_true x target hdec
          have h_head : (x :: xs).get? 0 = some target := congrArg some hx
          h_head
    | false =>
      fun h =>
        have hb := searchAux_bounds xs target (currIdx + 1) idx h
        have ih := searchAux_get xs target (currIdx + 1) idx h
        have h_sub : idx - currIdx = (idx - (currIdx + 1)) + 1 :=
          nat_sub_succ_eq currIdx idx hb.left
        have h_get : (x :: xs).get? ((idx - (currIdx + 1)) + 1) = xs.get? (idx - (currIdx + 1)) := rfl
        Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (x :: xs).get? p = some target) (Eq.symm h_sub))
          (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => p = some target) (Eq.symm h_get)) ih)

def searchAux_first : ∀ (l : List Nat) (target currIdx idx j : Nat),
    searchAux l target currIdx = Result.ok idx →
    currIdx ≤ j →
    j < idx →
    l.get? (j - currIdx) = some target → False
  | [], _, _, _, _, h, _, _, _ => nomatch h
  | x :: xs, target, currIdx, idx, j =>
    match hdec : x == target with
    | true =>
      fun h hj1 hj2 _ =>
        match h with
        | rfl =>
          have h_lt : currIdx < currIdx := nat_le_trans (nat_succ_le_succ hj1) hj2
          nat_lt_irrefl currIdx h_lt
    | false =>
      fun h hj1 hj2 hget =>
        match hjdec : j == currIdx with
        | true =>
          have hj_eq : j = currIdx := nat_eq_of_beq_true j currIdx hjdec
          have h_sub : j - currIdx = 0 :=
            match hj_eq with
            | rfl => rfl
          have h_some : some x = some target :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (x :: xs).get? p = some target) h_sub) hget
          have hx_eq : x = target :=
            match h_some with
            | rfl => rfl
          have hx_true : (x == target) = true :=
            match hx_eq with
            | rfl => nat_beq_refl x
          have hcontra : false = true := Eq.trans (Eq.symm hdec) hx_true
          False.elim (false_ne_true hcontra)
        | false =>
          have hj_succ : currIdx + 1 ≤ j := nat_succ_le_of_le_and_ne hj1 hjdec
          have h_sub : j - currIdx = (j - (currIdx + 1)) + 1 :=
            nat_sub_succ_eq currIdx j hj_succ
          have h_get_tail : (x :: xs).get? ((j - (currIdx + 1)) + 1) = xs.get? (j - (currIdx + 1)) := rfl
          have h_xs_get : xs.get? (j - (currIdx + 1)) = some target :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => p = some target) h_get_tail)
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (x :: xs).get? p = some target) h_sub) hget)
          searchAux_first xs target (currIdx + 1) idx j h hj_succ hj2 h_xs_get

def searchAux_notFound : ∀ (l : List Nat) (target currIdx j : Nat),
    searchAux l target currIdx = Result.err ZigError.NotFound →
    currIdx ≤ j →
    j < currIdx + l.length →
    l.get? (j - currIdx) = some target → False
  | [], _, currIdx, j, h, hj1, hj2, _ =>
    have h_lt : currIdx < currIdx := nat_lt_of_lt_zero_add hj2
    have h_lt2 : currIdx < currIdx := nat_le_trans (nat_succ_le_succ hj1) h_lt
    nat_lt_irrefl currIdx h_lt2
  | x :: xs, target, currIdx, j =>
    match hdec : x == target with
    | true =>
      fun h => nomatch h
    | false =>
      fun h hj1 hj2 hget =>
        match hjdec : j == currIdx with
        | true =>
          have hj_eq : j = currIdx := nat_eq_of_beq_true j currIdx hjdec
          have h_sub : j - currIdx = 0 :=
            match hj_eq with
            | rfl => rfl
          have h_some : some x = some target :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (x :: xs).get? p = some target) h_sub) hget
          have hx_eq : x = target :=
            match h_some with
            | rfl => rfl
          have hx_true : (x == target) = true :=
            match hx_eq with
            | rfl => nat_beq_refl x
          have hcontra : false = true := Eq.trans (Eq.symm hdec) hx_true
          False.elim (false_ne_true hcontra)
        | false =>
          have hj_succ : currIdx + 1 ≤ j := nat_succ_le_of_le_and_ne hj1 hjdec
          have hj2_assoc : j < (currIdx + 1) + xs.length :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun t => j + 1 ≤ t) (nat_add_right_succ currIdx xs.length)) hj2
          have h_sub : j - currIdx = (j - (currIdx + 1)) + 1 :=
            nat_sub_succ_eq currIdx j hj_succ
          have h_get_tail : (x :: xs).get? ((j - (currIdx + 1)) + 1) = xs.get? (j - (currIdx + 1)) := rfl
          have h_xs_get : xs.get? (j - (currIdx + 1)) = some target :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => p = some target) h_get_tail)
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (x :: xs).get? p = some target) h_sub) hget)
          searchAux_notFound xs target (currIdx + 1) j h hj_succ hj2_assoc h_xs_get

def searchAux_complete : ∀ (l : List Nat) (target currIdx k : Nat),
    currIdx ≤ k →
    k < currIdx + l.length →
    l.get? (k - currIdx) = some target →
    Σ idx, searchAux l target currIdx = Result.ok idx ∧ idx ≤ k
  | [], _, currIdx, k, hk1, hk2, _ =>
    have h_lt : currIdx < currIdx := nat_lt_of_lt_zero_add hk2
    have h_lt2 : currIdx < currIdx := nat_le_trans (nat_succ_le_succ hk1) h_lt
    False.elim (nat_lt_irrefl currIdx h_lt2)
  | x :: xs, target, currIdx, k =>
    match hdec : x == target with
    | true =>
      fun hk1 _ _ =>
        Sigma.mk currIdx (And.intro rfl hk1)
    | false =>
      fun hk1 hk2 hget =>
        match hkdec : k == currIdx with
        | true =>
          have hk_eq : k = currIdx := nat_eq_of_beq_true k currIdx hkdec
          have h_sub : k - currIdx = 0 :=
            match hk_eq with
            | rfl => rfl
          have h_some : some x = some target :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (x :: xs).get? p = some target) h_sub) hget
          have hx_eq : x = target :=
            match h_some with
            | rfl => rfl
          have hx_true : (x == target) = true :=
            match hx_eq with
            | rfl => nat_beq_refl x
          have hcontra : false = true := Eq.trans (Eq.symm hdec) hx_true
          False.elim (false_ne_true hcontra)
        | false =>
          have hk_succ : currIdx + 1 ≤ k := nat_succ_le_of_le_and_ne hk1 hkdec
          have hk2_assoc : k < (currIdx + 1) + xs.length :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun t => k + 1 ≤ t) (nat_add_right_succ currIdx xs.length)) hk2
          have h_sub : k - currIdx = (k - (currIdx + 1)) + 1 :=
            nat_sub_succ_eq currIdx k hk_succ
          have h_get_tail : (x :: xs).get? ((k - (currIdx + 1)) + 1) = xs.get? (k - (currIdx + 1)) := rfl
          have h_xs_get : xs.get? (k - (currIdx + 1)) = some target :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => p = some target) h_get_tail)
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun p => (x :: xs).get? p = some target) h_sub) hget)
          searchAux_complete xs target (currIdx + 1) k hk_succ hk2_assoc h_xs_get

theorem zigLen_eq_length (s : ZigSlice Nat) :
    zigLen s = s.elements.length := rfl

theorem zigGet_ok_iff (s : ZigSlice Nat) (i : Nat) (v : Nat) :
    zigGet s i = Result.ok v ↔ s.elements.get? i = some v :=
  match h : s.elements.get? i with
  | some x =>
    Iff.intro
      (fun hg =>
        match hg with
        | rfl => h)
      (fun hspec =>
        match hspec with
        | rfl => rfl)
  | none =>
    Iff.intro
      (fun hg => nomatch hg)
      (fun hspec => nomatch (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h) hspec))

theorem zigLinearSearch_overflow_eq (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target : Nat)
    (h : s.elements.length > MAX_USIZE) :
    zigLinearSearch s target = Result.err ZigError.Overflow :=
  if hdec : s.elements.length > MAX_USIZE then
    rfl
  else
    False.elim (hdec h)

theorem zigLinearSearch_no_overflow_eq (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target : Nat)
    (h : ¬ (s.elements.length > MAX_USIZE)) :
    zigLinearSearch s target = searchAux s.elements target 0 :=
  if hdec : s.elements.length > MAX_USIZE then
    False.elim (h hdec)
  else
    rfl

theorem search_no_overflow_of_ok (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target idx : Nat)
    (h : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.ok idx) :
    searchAux s.elements target 0 = Result.ok idx :=
  if hov : s.elements.length > MAX_USIZE then
    have h_err : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.err ZigError.Overflow :=
      zigLinearSearch_overflow_eq s target hov
    have h_contra : Result.err ZigError.Overflow = Result.ok idx :=
      Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_err) h
    nomatch h_contra
  else
    have h_eq : zigLinearSearch s target = searchAux s.elements target 0 :=
      zigLinearSearch_no_overflow_eq s target hov
    Eq.mp (congrArg (fun f => f = Result.ok idx) h_eq) h

theorem search_no_overflow_of_notFound (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target : Nat)
    (h : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.err ZigError.NotFound) :
    searchAux s.elements target 0 = Result.err ZigError.NotFound :=
  if hov : s.elements.length > MAX_USIZE then
    have h_err : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.err ZigError.Overflow :=
      zigLinearSearch_overflow_eq s target hov
    have h_contra : Result.err ZigError.Overflow = Result.err ZigError.NotFound :=
      Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_err) h
    nomatch h_contra
  else
    have h_eq : zigLinearSearch s target = searchAux s.elements target 0 :=
      zigLinearSearch_no_overflow_eq s target hov
    Eq.mp (congrArg (fun f => f = Result.err ZigError.NotFound) h_eq) h

theorem zigLinearSearch_soundness (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target idx : Nat)
    (h : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.ok idx) :
    idx < zigLen s ∧ zigGet s idx = Result.ok target :=
  have h_aux := search_no_overflow_of_ok s target idx h
  have hb := searchAux_bounds s.elements target 0 idx h_aux
  have hg := searchAux_get s.elements target 0 idx h_aux
  have hlen : idx < zigLen s := nat_lt_of_lt_zero_add hb.right
  have hget : zigGet s idx = Result.ok target := (zigGet_ok_iff s idx target).mpr hg
  And.intro hlen hget

theorem zigLinearSearch_first (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target idx j : Nat)
    (h : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.ok idx)
    (hj : j < idx) :
    zigGet s j ≠ Result.ok target :=
  have h_aux := search_no_overflow_of_ok s target idx h
  fun hget =>
    have hget_elem : s.elements.get? j = some target := (zigGet_ok_iff s j target).mp hget
    searchAux_first s.elements target 0 idx j h_aux (nat_zero_le j) hj hget_elem

theorem zigLinearSearch_notFound_sound (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target j : Nat)
    (h : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.err ZigError.NotFound)
    (hj : j < zigLen s) :
    zigGet s j ≠ Result.ok target :=
  have h_aux := search_no_overflow_of_notFound s target h
  fun hget =>
    have hget_elem : s.elements.get? j = some target := (zigGet_ok_iff s j target).mp hget
    searchAux_notFound s.elements target 0 j h_aux (nat_zero_le j) (nat_lt_zero_add hj) hget_elem

theorem zigLinearSearch_completeness (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target k : Nat)
    (hno_overflow : zigLen s ≤ MAX_USIZE)
    (hk : k < zigLen s)
    (hget : zigGet s k = Result.ok target) :
    Σ idx, zigLinearSearch s target = Result.ok idx ∧ idx ≤ k :=
  have hget_elem : s.elements.get? k = some target := (zigGet_ok_iff s k target).mp hget
  have ⟨idx, h_aux, hle⟩ := searchAux_complete s.elements target 0 k (nat_zero_le k) (nat_lt_zero_add hk) hget_elem
  have h_search : zigLinearSearch s target = Result.ok idx :=
    if hdec : s.elements.length > MAX_USIZE then
      have hbad : MAX_USIZE < MAX_USIZE := nat_le_trans hdec hno_overflow
      False.elim (nat_lt_irrefl MAX_USIZE hbad)
    else
      have h_eq : zigLinearSearch s target = searchAux s.elements target 0 :=
        zigLinearSearch_no_overflow_eq s target hdec
      Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun f => f = Result.ok idx) h_eq) h_aux
  Sigma.mk idx (And.intro h_search hle)

theorem zigLinearSearch_correctness (s : ZigSlice Nat) (target : Nat) (idx : Nat)
    (hno_overflow : zigLen s ≤ MAX_USIZE) :
    zigLinearSearch s target = Result.ok idx ↔
    (idx < zigLen s ∧ zigGet s idx = Result.ok target ∧ ∀ j, j < idx → zigGet s j ≠ Result.ok target) :=
  Iff.intro
    (fun h =>
      have hsound := zigLinearSearch_soundness s target idx h
      have hfirst := fun j hj => zigLinearSearch_first s target idx j h hj
      And.intro hsound.left (And.intro hsound.right hfirst))
    (fun hspec =>
      have ⟨hbound, hget, hfirst⟩ := hspec
      have ⟨idx', ⟨hok', hle'⟩⟩ := zigLinearSearch_completeness s target idx hno_overflow hbound hget
      have hdec : idx' = idx :=
        match h_cmp : idx' == idx with
        | true => nat_eq_of_beq_true idx' idx h_cmp
        | false =>
          have hlt : idx' < idx := nat_succ_le_of_le_and_ne_left hle' h_cmp
          have hbad : zigGet s idx' ≠ Result.ok target := hfirst idx' hlt
          have hgood : zigGet s idx' = Result.ok target := (zigLinearSearch_soundness s target idx' hok').right
          False.elim (hbad hgood)
      match hdec with
      | rfl => hok')

def eraseU32 (x : U32) : Nat := x.val

def eraseSliceU32 (s : ZigSliceU32) : ZigSlice Nat :=
  ⟨s.elements.map eraseU32⟩

def zigLenU32 (s : ZigSliceU32) : Nat :=
  s.elements.length

def zigGetU32 (s : ZigSliceU32) (idx : Nat) : Result ZigError U32 :=
  match s.elements.get? idx with
  | some v => Result.ok v
  | none => Result.err ZigError.IndexOutOfBounds

def wrap_idx (idx : Nat) : Result ZigError USize :=
  match Nat.decLe idx MAX_USIZE with
  | isTrue h => Result.ok ⟨idx, h⟩
  | isFalse _ => Result.err ZigError.Overflow

def zigLinearSearchU32 (s : ZigSliceU32) (target : U32) : Result ZigError USize :=
  match zigLinearSearch (eraseSliceU32 s) target.val with
  | Result.ok idx => wrap_idx idx
  | Result.err e => Result.err e

def list_get_map {α β : Type} (f : α → β) : ∀ (l : List α) (i : Nat),
    (l.map f).get? i = match l.get? i with | some x => some (f x) | none => none
  | [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, 0 => rfl
  | _ :: xs, i + 1 => list_get_map f xs i

def list_length_map {α β : Type} (f : α → β) : ∀ (l : List α),
    (l.map f).length = l.length
  | [] => rfl
  | _ :: xs => congrArg Nat.succ (list_length_map f xs)

theorem eraseSlice_length (s : ZigSliceU32) :
    (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.length = zigLenU32 s :=
  list_length_map eraseU32 s.elements

theorem eraseSlice_get (s : ZigSliceU32) (i : Nat) :
    (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i =
      match s.elements.get? i with
      | some v => some v.val
      | none => none :=
  list_get_map eraseU32 s.elements i

theorem zigGetU32_ok_implies_get_some (s : ZigSliceU32) (i : Nat) (v : U32)
    (h : zigGetU32 s i = Result.ok v) :
    (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i = some v.val :=
  match hg : s.elements.get? i with
  | some x =>
    have h_ok : zigGetU32 s i = Result.ok x :=
      Eq.mp (congrArg (fun opt =>
        (match opt with
         | some y => Result.ok y
         | none => Result.err ZigError.IndexOutOfBounds) = Result.ok x) (Eq.symm hg)) rfl
    have hxv : x = v :=
      match Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_ok) h with
      | rfl => rfl
    have hmap : (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i =
        match s.elements.get? i with
        | some y => some y.val
        | none => none := eraseSlice_get s i
    have hmap' : (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i = some x.val :=
      Eq.mp (congrArg (fun opt =>
        (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i =
          match opt with
          | some y => some y.val
          | none => none) (Eq.symm hg)) hmap
    Eq.mp (congrArg (fun t => (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i = some t.val) hxv) hmap'
  | none =>
    have h_err : zigGetU32 s i = Result.err ZigError.IndexOutOfBounds :=
      Eq.mp (congrArg (fun opt =>
        (match opt with
         | some y => Result.ok y
         | none => Result.err ZigError.IndexOutOfBounds) = Result.err ZigError.IndexOutOfBounds) (Eq.symm hg)) rfl
    nomatch (Eq.trans (Eq.symm h_err) h)

theorem get_some_implies_zigGetU32_ok (s : ZigSliceU32) (i : Nat) (v : U32)
    (h : (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i = some v.val) :
    zigGetU32 s i = Result.ok v :=
  match hg : s.elements.get? i with
  | some x =>
    have hmap : (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i =
        match s.elements.get? i with
        | some y => some y.val
        | none => none := eraseSlice_get s i
    have hmap' : (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i = some x.val :=
      Eq.mp (congrArg (fun opt =>
        (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i =
          match opt with
          | some y => some y.val
          | none => none) (Eq.symm hg)) hmap
    have hxval : some x.val = some v.val := Eq.trans (Eq.symm hmap') h
    have hxvval : x.val = v.val :=
      match hxval with
      | rfl => rfl
    have hxv : x = v := Subtype.eq hxvval
    have h_ok : zigGetU32 s i = Result.ok x :=
      Eq.mp (congrArg (fun opt =>
        (match opt with
         | some y => Result.ok y
         | none => Result.err ZigError.IndexOutOfBounds) = Result.ok x) (Eq.symm hg)) rfl
    Eq.mp (congrArg (fun t => zigGetU32 s i = Result.ok t) hxv) h_ok
  | none =>
    have hmap : (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i =
        match s.elements.get? i with
        | some y => some y.val
        | none => none := eraseSlice_get s i
    have hmap' : (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i = none :=
      Eq.mp (congrArg (fun opt =>
        (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i =
          match opt with
          | some y => some y.val
          | none => none) (Eq.symm hg)) hmap
    nomatch (Eq.trans (Eq.symm hmap') h)

theorem zigGetU32_ok_iff (s : ZigSliceU32) (i : Nat) (v : U32) :
    zigGetU32 s i = Result.ok v ↔ (eraseSliceU32 s).elements.get? i = some v.val :=
  Iff.intro
